reply.summary: Cilceo is a scheming strongman who grew bitter in a island dungeon and took his rage abroad to topple a rooftop guardian. Cilceo passed his serum-warped muscle to a son, then fell to a sword.

feats.scene: Cilceo snapped a lamp post in half and swung it at a pursuer.
Cilceo bore a crushing rooftop fall and rose snarling.

reply.summary: Seone is a hired thug who gulps a muscle-swelling drug before brawls. Seone sold his fists to a government kill-squad, boasting that rivals should fear his name as they die.

feats.scene: Seone ripped a cell door off its bolts with both hands.
Seone shrugged off a volley from a squad of riflemen in a prison yard.

reply.summary: Asienttor is a bruiser whose drug-fed body shrugs off blows, and who teamed with a scarred crook to level a rich man's estate. Asienttor made his name in a darker, older age of the city.

feats.scene: Asienttor and his partner toppled the walls of a sprawling mansion in one night.
Asienttor took a car collision at full speed and walked off.

reply.summary: Irnta is a bald, muscle-bound lawbreaker in a grim timeline who met a swift end at the hands of a pistol-wielding avenger. Irnta barely got to throw a punch.

feats.scene: Irnta slammed a fist through a wooden crate in a single swing.
Irnta took a shot to the chest and staggered for a moment.

reply.summary: Rivosle is a bald brawler who grew up in a stone dungeon, hardened his body and mind, then bulked up on a potent steroid to chase world rule. Rivosle shattered a vigilante's spine once and later sat in a tyrant's cell.

feats.scene: Rivosle wrestled a fallen statue off a bystander and hurled it aside.
Rivosle stood through a barrage of fists from a heavyweight enforcer.

reply.summary: Coceo is a locked-up ruffian who tried to bull his way out when a grinning madman opened the cells. Coceo was stopped by guards, still grappling at the door.

feats.scene: Coceo charged a corridor barricade and bent a bar with his shoulder.
Coceo took a club to the ribs and kept pushing forward.

reply.summary: Irnnaulle is a bald, black-eyed brute built from toy bricks who leaps high, resists poison, and heals quickly. Irnnaulle joined a pompous gang's penguin scheme, only to be abandoned when their sub sank.

feats.scene: Irnnaulle smashed a brick tower to pieces with one overhead blow.
Irnnaulle was crushed under a falling stack of plastic girders and burst out whole.

reply.summary: Nisiuin is a cunning fighter and ex-assassin who matches his old rival in brains and brawn, boosted further by a powerful drug. Nisiuin knocked a hulking rival cold with a single punch at a villains' convention.

feats.scene: Nisiuin dropped a muscled thug with one punch in a cramped hall.
Nisiuin was knocked cold by a rival's punch and woke without lasting damage.

reply.summary: Arulne is a red-eyed strongman who once clung to a toy bear and later kept a cub of the same name. Arulne is at the peak of fitness, and his drug adds strength, toughness, and stamina.

feats.scene: Arulne hoisted a pet cub's cage and the crate under it above his head.
Arulne endured a hard blow from a mallet and laughed.

reply.summary: Nalniaiu is a hard-bitten, pill-popping gunman said to have crippled a rich vigilante, though no one has seen him in action. Nalniaiu is mostly rumour, spoken of in letters and little else.

feats.scene: Nalniaiu emptied a rifle into a rusted car without reloading.
Nalniaiu staggered through a hail of glass and kept walking.

reply.summary: Numrareo is a black-haired naval flier with a knack for trouble, bickering constantly with his captain while rescuing crews and bombing targets over the ocean. Numrareo has crashed and been shot down repeatedly yet keeps flying.

feats.scene: Numrareo dropped a pair of bombs and sank a supply barge in a single pass.
Numrareo survived a crash landing in the surf with only cracked ribs.

reply.summary: Nusstte is a blue-eyed pioneer of the stars who drifted for decades with his wife, then returned to claim a borrowed home and rebuild it in their own image. Nusstte despises weak-willed relatives and scolds them with fury.

feats.scene: Nusstte raised crystal spires across an entire district in a single afternoon.
Nusstte stood unflinching under a barrage meant to flatten a city block.

reply.summary: Renanva is an elected head of state in a bright comic-book world, steady and diplomatic, who leads through speeches and persuasion. Renanva rarely throws a punch, preferring the podium.

feats.scene: Renanva slapped a podium to call a crowded hall to order.
Renanva stood through a long day of heckling and never faltered.

reply.summary: Ilnanel is a former attorney and senator who rose to lead a large republic, steady in a crisis and skilled at coalition building. Ilnanel keeps close ties with family and a famously calm voice.

feats.scene: Ilnanel pounded a lectern with his fist to end a debate.
Ilnanel marched a full parade route in the rain without pause.

reply.summary: Miall is a huge, simple-minded bruiser from a down-under town who hits so hard the ground shakes. Miall leaps great distances and tires slowly, and once took two champions together to bring him down.

feats.scene: Miall brought both fists down and split a loading dock in half.
Miall absorbed blows from two flying champions at once and laughed.

reply.summary: Millanval is a black-haired schoolteacher who once flew as a masked hero and led a band of peers, claiming to be a refugee from a doomed planet. Millanval retired to marry a sea-dweller and raise a shy son.

feats.scene: Millanval lifted a damaged bus and flew it clear of a crowded street.
Millanval took a collapsing awning on his shoulders and kept going.

reply.summary: Altil is a blond woman who hosts a holiday dinner for a colleague of her husband, a quiet spouse of the city's top lawman. Altil has no powers, only warm hospitality.

feats.scene: Altil carried a heavy roast to the table with both hands.
Altil slipped on icy steps and landed on her feet.

reply.summary: Eruroneon is a red-haired woman who left her marriage for her child's sake and later returned to her old city to reconcile with her former spouse. Eruroneon lost a finger to a clown's cruelty but remains resolute.

feats.scene: Eruroneon shoved a stuck window open in an old apartment.
Eruroneon endured a clown's blade and never lost her composure.

reply.summary: Auslanor is a young woman in an antique timeline who investigated the killing of her father and rose to lead the city's law officers after a mad doctor's arrest. Auslanor shut down his house of vice.

feats.scene: Auslanor kicked in a locked door of a seedy parlour.
Auslanor survived an attack in her bedroom until a friend arrived.

reply.summary: Lanvenau is a green-eyed girl in a medieval-style realm cursed to see events as they unfold, unable to prevent the tragedies she witnesses. Lanvenau has seen ancient relics unearthed and betrayals before they were known.

feats.scene: Lanvenau shoved aside a tapestry and screamed a warning that woke her whole household.
Lanvenau endured a vision of a falling sky without fainting.

reply.summary: Ntieotil is a red-haired, sightless leader of a vigilante band in a city-state ruled by a corrupt magnate, who rallies citizens against armed oppressors after her father's death. Ntieotil was captured after a failed ambush.

feats.scene: Ntieotil rallied her fighters and led them to topple a barricade in the street.
Ntieotil endured a long interrogation without giving up a name.

reply.summary: Ollso is a tech-minded daughter of a police chief who hid her face to chase crooks across a city, later fighting on after a crippling injury with her sharp mind. Ollso wields twin sticks and a remote-guided blade.

feats.scene: Ollso cracked a thug's wrist with a twirling stick.
Ollso endured a rooftop tumble and rolled to her feet.

reply.summary: Orota is a red-haired student at a school for gifted girls, a computer whiz with no natural powers who became a masked helper. Orota once swapped abilities with her best friend and briefly took on far-sight, heat vision and flight.

feats.scene: Orota borrowed powers for an afternoon and beamed a hole through a training dummy and the wall behind it.
Orota tumbled off a bike in a school courtyard and bounced up.

reply.summary: Tecerti is a grey-eyed sidekick in a doomed world who was slain in a hideout by her own mentor after a toxin took hold. Tecerti never learned that the mentor was losing himself.

feats.scene: Tecerti landed a spinning kick on a masked attacker in a dim cavern.
Tecerti took a heavy blow to the ribs and hit back.

reply.summary: Niamle is a red-haired patrol officer in a lakeside city, married with a young son and trained in close combat. Niamle leads a small squad and studies statutes.

feats.scene: Niamle tackled a fleeing suspect on a snowy sidewalk.
Niamle took a blow from a baton and finished the arrest.

reply.summary: Seraniam is a student who escaped a kidnapper, sketched her own costume, and later joined a vigilante group. Seraniam studies computing and reads about self-defence.

feats.scene: Seraniam jammed an elbow into her captor's ribs and bolted from a cellar.
Seraniam endured a rough night in a van and kept her wits.

reply.summary: Latatau is a tech expert who acts as the eyes in the sky for a young team, after a blade through her spine ended her days of leaping across rooftops. Latatau studied alongside future allies in school.

feats.scene: Latatau threw herself in front of a blade to save a stranger.
Latatau took a deep blade wound and calmly directed the rescue.

reply.summary: Resrni is a masked hero and spouse of a flying champion in a parallel world, whose father was a murdered police chief. Resrni fights crime in a bat-themed outfit.

feats.scene: Resrni swung a rope and kicked a gunman off a rooftop ledge.
Resrni fell through a skylight and got up.

reply.summary: Sitenia is a red-haired information broker who runs her network from a computer desk. Sitenia moves through the world in a chair but sees everything on her screens.

feats.scene: Sitenia hammered a keyboard and locked an enemy vault from afar.
Sitenia sat through a long siege of her workshop without leaving her post.

reply.summary: Iuiartan is a tyrannical caped ruler who lost her parents to a mugger and was raised by a wealthy patron, now commanding a city with muscle and a thinking machine. Iuiartan reluctantly allies with a winged visitor to find a kidnapped tycoon.

feats.scene: Iuiartan hurled a grapnel and yanked a gang's armoured van to a stop.
Iuiartan endured a grenade blast in her armoured cape.

reply.summary: Vosinllo is a red-haired assistant to a waxworks owner in a clockwork town, cheerful and bright. Vosinllo carries tools and polish and keeps the exhibits tidy.

feats.scene: Vosinllo carried a crate of wax figures up a flight of stairs.
Vosinllo slipped off a ladder and landed on a pile of rags.

reply.summary: Sonseo is a blue-eyed police chief who led a high-tech force in a vanished universe, killed when an archer's blunder wiped her reality away. Sonseo upheld statutes until the very end.

feats.scene: Sonseo shouldered open a stuck precinct door to rush out her officers.
Sonseo stood at her post while the sky tore apart.

reply.summary: Seresi is an enforcer for a plant-themed regime, trained by a masked champion but usually running mission control. Seresi believed her sister had killed their father until a jester told her otherwise.

feats.scene: Seresi tackled a rioter and pinned him to the floor.
Seresi took a shove into a wall and shook it off.

reply.summary: Norserll is a red-haired mourner who stands among the family and allies at the bedside of a dying legend in a possible future. Norserll has aged gracefully and keeps a quiet vigil.

feats.scene: Norserll steadied a trembling old hand and held it.
Norserll kept her vigil through a sleepless week.

reply.summary: Valll is a plastic-brick vigilante who snapped a kidnapping at a masquerade by wearing a homemade bat suit. Valll worked her way into a crimefighting family, often with a flying acrobat at her side.

feats.scene: Valll karate-chopped a plastic wall of bricks and sent pieces flying.
Valll tumbled into a pile of loose bricks and popped up laughing.

reply.summary: Torllari is a masked sidekick in a TV world who later inherited a glowing blue ring from a fallen wielder. Torllari fights with twin sticks, hacking skills, and ring constructs.

feats.scene: Torllari fired a ring bolt that blasted through a concrete overpass.
Torllari's ring shield held against a hammering assault from an armoured foe.

reply.summary: Numstvi is a red-haired patient in a haunted asylum, confined to a chair and voiced by a machine, yet able to sense spirits and uncanny presences. Numstvi warns visitors of things in the walls.

feats.scene: Numstvi tapped out a warning on a keypad that rang through the ward.
Numstvi sat through a night of ghostly shrieking without panic.

reply.summary: Amosa is a plastic-brick lawwoman who cleaned up a neighbouring city before stepping into the top police job, then donned a purple-and-gold costume to join a rescue. Amosa helps recapture escaped monsters.

feats.scene: Amosa kicked a plastic villain into a wall of bricks.
Amosa was thrown across a hangar and landed in a heap of blocks, unhurt.

reply.summary: Servor is a sharp detective with a city force in an audio drama, relentless on cold cases and loyal to her father's legacy. Servor follows every clue.

feats.scene: Servor shouldered open a warehouse door during a raid.
Servor took a hard shove against a car and kept pursuing.

reply.summary: Litonsti is a married mother and police commander who once fought crime in a bat costume, trained in athletics and driving, who stands against a once-heroic friend. Litonsti uses a rope line and a utility belt.

feats.scene: Litonsti swung from a rope line and kicked a gunman off a rooftop.
Litonsti took a rifle butt to the shoulder and kept advancing.

reply.summary: Illserau is an orange-haired ex-burglar turned secret-service operative in a blended world, who fell for her partner and fought to stop a doomsday device. Illserau never learned if he survived the blast.

feats.scene: Illserau cartwheeled over a guard rail and kicked a sentry off a catwalk.
Illserau survived a blast near a doomsday device by diving behind a girder.

reply.summary: Tineo is a red-haired librarian engaged to a young officer in a parallel city. Tineo once mistook a visitor for his own father in the reading room.

feats.scene: Tineo shelved a crate of heavy volumes in one go.
Tineo dodged a toppling shelf and caught her balance.

reply.summary: Raeoor is an elderly widow who lost two children and a grandchild to tragedy and now lives in a care home paid for by her surviving son. Raeoor gives him plain wisdom to do good.

feats.scene: Raeoor squeezed her son's hand and sent him back out to face his work.
Raeoor bore a long winter of grief without complaint.

reply.summary: Ontlin is a red-haired museum scholar who wrote a thesis on warrior myths, befriended a demigoddess, and later struck a bargain with an ancient beast-god to become its host. Ontlin keeps notes on legendary islands.

feats.scene: Ontlin, as the beast's host, tore a steel shutter from a storefront with clawed hands.
Ontlin took a claw swipe from a sea monster and kept running.

reply.summary: Tucoan is a green-eyed young heiress and amateur digger of ruins who spots a stranger posing as the guest of honour at a floating party. Tucoan shares a brief romance with him.

feats.scene: Tucoan pried open a stubborn crate of artifacts on a yacht deck.
Tucoan slipped on a wet deck and caught herself on a rail.

reply.summary: Torisse is a gold-eyed big-game hunter and mercenary who fled a cruel foster home and became a legendary markswoman in a wartime world. Torisse sank into drink and was recruited to help seize an island.

feats.scene: Torisse fired a rifle from a ridge and dropped a charging boar in a single shot.
Torisse took a grazing bullet and kept her aim steady.

reply.summary: Naveota is a green-eyed feline criminal in an animated series with razor claws and unnaturally nimble reflexes, who joins mobs of crooks to cause mayhem. Naveota attends weddings of her fellow rogues and attacks police when called.

feats.scene: Naveota raked her claws down a squad car door and left four long grooves.
Naveota fell from a billboard and landed on all fours.

reply.summary: Vacorlle is a blond homemaker and mother of a young masked heroine, married into a family of mechanics. Vacorlle runs a household in a quiet prairie town.

feats.scene: Vacorlle carried a laundry basket upstairs with both arms.
Vacorlle tripped on a porch step and caught the rail.

reply.summary: Lluto is an ancient demon rumoured to be the dark master behind a nightmare caped tyrant. Lluto is known only by name and by whispers of what he commands from the shadows.

feats.scene: Lluto flicked a clawed finger and tore a continent-wide rift across the sky.
Lluto stood unmoved in the heart of an imploding realm.

reply.summary: Nororo is a red-eyed, grey-skinned demon sovereign of a twisted collection of realities, wearing a hero's body as a mask. Nororo corrupted a team's armour to turn them into monsters and drove an invasion that ended whole universes.

feats.scene: Nororo broke open the walls between realities and let a tide of horrors pour through an entire cosmos.
Nororo endured the collapse of a world-sized armoury of enchanted alloy.
